title_en: Character Riddles (6/20): Three People Make a Crowd
note_en: The text quotes the saying 人多力量大，众人拾柴火焰高 "more people, more strength; when everyone gathers firewood, the flames burn higher." Like many Chinese sayings, it is two balanced clauses with no "if" or "when": the first state simply leads to the second. English needs a linking word ("when everyone gathers"), while Chinese relies on juxtaposition alone.
